cases.name: knowledge-index: rebuilds the example's INDEX.md byte for byte
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/ki-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R; mkdir -p $R/.claude $R/docs; cp -R {{KIT}}/examples/docs/business $R/docs/
printf '%s' '{"knowledge": {"contexts": {"Catalog": "CAT"}}}' > $R/.claude/kit.config.json
cd $R; export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R; I="python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/knowledge-index.py"; A="python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/ask.py"
rm docs/business/INDEX.md; $I; cmp docs/business/INDEX.md {{KIT}}/examples/docs/business/INDEX.md && echo SAME

expect.stdout:
indexed: 10 object(s) — 7 file(s) parsed, 0 unchanged; INDEX.md written
SAME
